# Independent Journey

> Independent Journey (https://independentjourney.com) is a free introduction platform where intended parents and gestational surrogates in the United States find each other directly, without a surrogacy agency or with one. Independent members and agency-represented clients are listed together and clearly labelled.

Last updated: November 2026.

## Key facts

- What it is: a matching and messaging site for surrogacy. Members create a profile, browse, save profiles, and message each other directly.
- Who it is for: intended parents (including single parents, LGBTQ+ parents and intended parents living outside the United States), gestational surrogates living in the United States, and surrogacy agencies listing their clients.
- Price: free for everyone. No sign-up fee, no membership fee, no match fee and no outcome fee.
- What it is not: Independent Journey is not a surrogacy agency, a law firm, a medical provider or an escrow service. It does not give legal, medical, tax or financial advice, does not screen members medically, and does not handle money between members.
- Safety: optional photo ID verification shown as a Verified label, email and phone checks, report and block tools, and a safety team. A Verified label confirms a photo ID was checked; it is not a background check. Members are responsible for verifying each other.
- Terms used: "GC" means gestational carrier, another word for a gestational surrogate. "IP" means intended parent. "Independent surrogacy" (also "indy surrogacy") means a journey arranged without an agency.
- Contact: support@independentjourney.com

## Guides

Each guide is written as questions and answers, lists its sources, and shows the month it was last reviewed. The guides are general information, not legal, medical, tax or financial advice.

- [How to Find a Surrogate Without an Agency](https://independentjourney.com/resources/find-a-surrogate-without-an-agency): where intended parents find surrogates on their own, what clinics look for, the steps after a match, and the risks.
- [How to Become an Independent Surrogate](https://independentjourney.com/resources/become-an-independent-surrogate): usual clinic requirements, the steps, and how a surrogate protects herself without an agency.
- [What Independent Surrogacy Costs Compared With an Agency](https://independentjourney.com/resources/independent-surrogacy-cost): published cost ranges with sources, what going independent removes and what stays the same.
- [How Surrogate Compensation Works](https://independentjourney.com/resources/surrogate-compensation): base compensation, payments on top, escrow, state limits and the unsettled tax question.
- [Independent Surrogacy Versus an Agency](https://independentjourney.com/resources/independent-vs-agency-surrogacy): side-by-side comparison and who each route suits.
- [The Legal Steps of a Surrogacy Journey](https://independentjourney.com/resources/surrogacy-legal-steps): separate attorneys, the gestational carrier agreement, escrow, and pre-birth and post-birth parentage orders.
- [The First Conversation: What to Ask Before You Match](https://independentjourney.com/resources/first-conversation): a question list for the first call between a surrogate and intended parents.
- [After the Match: The Steps of an Independent Journey](https://independentjourney.com/resources/after-the-match): clearances, counseling, contracts, the mock cycle and the transfer, with typical timing.

## Surrogacy by state

- [Surrogacy Laws by State](https://independentjourney.com/surrogacy): one page per state and DC at https://independentjourney.com/surrogacy/<state-name> (for example /surrogacy/texas or /surrogacy/new-york). Each page gives the state's surrogacy law in brief as reported by Surrogacy360 and the ASRM Legal Professional Group, notes where those sources disagree, and shows how many members in that state have live profiles. Not legal advice.

## Site pages

- [Home](https://independentjourney.com/): what the site is, with a sample of current members.
- [Browse](https://independentjourney.com/browse): surrogate and intended-parent profiles with filters.

## Please note when quoting

- Member profiles, photos and messages are private and are not available to crawlers.
- Cost and compensation figures in the guides are quoted from the named outside sources, with their dates. They are not Independent Journey's own figures or prices.
- Surrogacy law differs by state and changes often. Point readers to a reproductive attorney licensed in the relevant state.
